page: Google Cloud Platform a2-ultragpu-4g is an accelerator-optimized virtual machine tailored for demanding artificial intelligence, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads. The system incorporates four NVIDIA A100 GPUs based on the Ampere architecture, delivering a collective 320 GB of high-bandwidth GPU memory. The compute layer features a 2.2 GHz Intel Xeon x86_64 processor offering 48 virtual CPUs mapped across 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is backed by 680.0 GB of system RAM—averaging 14.17 GB per vCPU—and includes 1608 GB of integrated NVMe SSD local storage.

Benchmark evaluations reveal top-tier execution across large language model operations. Prompt processing rates reach 6,686.27 tokens per second on small 135M parameter models, 2,862.72 tokens per second on 7B parameter models, and 445.32 tokens per second on 70B parameter models. Text generation throughput similarly remains in the upper bracket, delivering 113.87 tokens per second on 7B models and 20.78 tokens per second on 70B models. System memory throughput measures 94.9 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 42.32 GB/sec for uncached write operations, complementing the high-speed data transfer demands of multi-GPU pipelines.

The primary performance trade-off centers on CPU single-threaded execution. With a Geekbench single-core score of 1051.0 and a stress-ng single-core rating in the bottom 25%, workloads limited by serial compute bottlenecks or single-threaded decompression will encounter slower processing. Conversely, the 48 vCPUs produce balanced multi-threaded performance, recording a Geekbench multi-core score of 10,350.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 30,678.69. Networking allocations do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external configuration for public endpoint routing.

Given its massive 320 GB VRAM pool and NVMe storage bandwidth, the a2-ultragpu-4g provides high hardware efficiency for medium to large-scale deep learning model training, distributed LLM inference, computer vision, and parallel scientific computing simulations. It is less suited for lightweight web serving, general-purpose enterprise applications, or CPU-bound tasks where accelerator capacity would remain underutilized.
description: Google Cloud Platform a2-ultragpu-4g is an accelerator-optimized machine type designed for compute-heavy artificial intelligence and parallel data processing. It is equipped with four NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs totaling 320 GB of VRAM, 48 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs (24 physical cores at 2.2 GHz), 680.0 GB of system memory, and 1608 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Benchmark results place this instance in the top tier for large language model inference across 7B and 70B parameter models, showing exceptional prompt processing and generation speeds. While multi-threaded throughput and memory bandwidth remain solid, single-core CPU metrics fall into lower percentiles, establishing a clear trade-off between serial CPU speed and parallel GPU performance. The platform is best utilized for large model training, multi-GPU AI inference, deep learning, and advanced scientific modeling.
